name: Pandora
description: Pandora is the Witch of Vainglory and the enigmatic Saintess presiding over the Witch Cult as a supernumerary Witch regarded as taboo across history. She orchestrated the assault on Elior Forest roughly a century prior to the main story, leading to the corruption of Petelgeuse Romanée-Conti and causing young Emilia to freeze the forest.
